# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the technical change.

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] DataOps portfolio
- [ ] MLOps portfolio

## Quality gates

- [ ] README or relevant documentation updated
- [ ] Public-safety rules respected
- [ ] No CV, cover letter, job tracker or employer-specific application material
- [ ] No real banking/client data
- [ ] No private school documents
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, hostnames, IPs, keys or licenses
- [ ] Synthetic or open data only
- [ ] Screenshots, if any, are sanitized

## Technical evidence

- [ ] Architecture documented
- [ ] Setup instructions documented
- [ ] Tests or validation checks included, if applicable
- [ ] Runbook or operational note included, if applicable
- [ ] Data card / model card included, if applicable
- [ ] Controls matrix updated, if applicable

Additional context.
